project_summary: Replace the paper diary of a three-dentist clinic with an online booking system for patients and a daily schedule for the receptionist.

tasks.title: Online appointment booking
tasks.description: Patients pick a dentist and a free time slot on the website and book an appointment without calling the clinic.
acceptance_criteria: A patient can book a free slot with any of the three dentists
A booked slot is no longer offered to other patients
tasks.source_quote: Patients should be able to book, move and cancel their own appointments from the website without calling us

tasks.title: Reschedule and cancel appointments
tasks.description: Patients move or cancel their own appointments from the website.
acceptance_criteria: A patient can move an appointment to another free slot
A cancelled appointment frees the slot again
tasks.source_quote: move and cancel their own appointments from the website

tasks.title: Receptionist daily schedule screen
tasks.description: One screen for clinic staff listing today's appointments for each dentist.
acceptance_criteria: The screen shows today's appointments grouped by dentist
New bookings and cancellations appear without manual work
tasks.source_quote: The receptionist needs one screen that shows today's appointments for each dentist

tasks.title: SMS reminder the day before the visit
tasks.description: Every patient receives an SMS reminder on the day before the appointment.
acceptance_criteria: An SMS is sent the day before each active appointment
No SMS is sent for cancelled appointments
tasks.source_quote: Patients must get an SMS reminder the day before the visit

tasks.title: Deposit payment at booking
tasks.description: Patients pay a deposit when they book. The amount and payment provider are not decided yet.
acceptance_criteria: A booking is confirmed only after the deposit is paid
tasks.source_quote: We also want to take a deposit when booking, but we have not decided on the amount yet

tasks.title: Mobile-friendly interface
tasks.description: All patient-facing pages work on phone screens.
acceptance_criteria: Booking, rescheduling and cancelling can be completed on a phone
tasks.source_quote: Everything has to work on phones, since most patients use them

tasks.title: Staff-only access to patient data (GDPR)
tasks.description: Patient data is visible to clinic staff only, and data handling follows GDPR.
acceptance_criteria: Patient data is not accessible without a staff login
Patients can request export and deletion of their data
tasks.source_quote: only clinic staff may see it and we need to follow GDPR

tasks.title: Waiting list for freed-up slots
tasks.description: Patients can join a waiting list and are offered slots that become free after cancellations.
acceptance_criteria: A freed-up slot is offered to patients on the waiting list
tasks.source_quote: It would be nice to have a waiting list that offers freed-up slots to other patients

open_questions: What is the deposit amount, and is it refunded when a patient cancels?
Which SMS and payment providers should be used, and who pays for them?
What is the exact launch date? "Before the summer holidays" is not a date.
What are the opening hours of the clinic and the appointment length per treatment?
